description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to the setup wizard of the SuiteCRM installation, mainly handling user interface interactions such as toggling password requirements, handling database setup options, and user privileges.

methods.name: togglePasswordRetypeRequired()
methods.description: Toggles the password retype requirement UI element based on whether the 'create sugarsales user' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: toggleDropTables()
methods.description: Enables or disables the option to drop existing tables depending on whether the 'create database' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: toggleUsernameIsPrivileged()
methods.description: Toggles display of privileged user information based on the state of the 'username is privileged' checkbox.
